comment: Pinned upstream release for the vendored CodeLLDB binaries. vendor-codelldb.js verifies every downloaded VSIX against these digests and fails the build on mismatch. To bump: set the new version, download each platform VSIX from the upstream release (fresh downloads, cross-checked by a second independent download — never a digest read off a vendor tree), compute sha256 for each, update this file, update DEFAULT_CODELLDB_VERSION in src/codelldb-resolver.ts, run scripts/sync-versions.cjs, re-vendor, and run the codelldb-common, rust, cpp and cobol test suites plus their e2e smokes; docs/release-checklist.md has the full procedure. See SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md (Embedded third-party components).
